title: Comparison and development of machine learning tools for the prediction of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in the Chinese population.
summary: Models combining clinical features and SNPs identified COPD-associated SNPs and predicted COPD in Chinese cohorts; the paper reports test-set performance, with risk associations and prediction limited to the studied population. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
